rows.traditional: 成 + CL + N + 都 + V
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose pattern for saying that something is found or happens in every part of a specified place or period.

example.english: There was a power cut throughout the city.
example.jyutping: sing4 go3 sing4 si5 dou1 ting4 din6

rows.note: Use this when the context makes the area clear and you want to stress that something is everywhere within it.

example.english: Throughout this shopping mall, people are queuing everywhere.
example.traditional: 呢個商場到處都有人排隊。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 soeng1 coeng4 dou3 cyu3 dou1 jau5 jan4 paai4 deoi6

rows.note: Use this for something that continues throughout an event or process from its beginning to its end.

example.traditional: 個講座由頭到尾都好悶
example.jyutping: go3 gong2 zo6 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 hou2 mun6

rows.note: Use this mainly for the whole duration of a journey, activity, or event.

example.english: I wore headphones throughout the trip.
example.traditional: 去旅行嗰陣，我全程都戴住耳機
example.jyutping: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 go2 zan6 ngo5 cyun4 cing4 dou1 daai3 zyu6 ji5 gei1
